blind_read: The monkey picks up a banana, carries it across, deposits it, then turns back.

The right edge of the muzzle, right shoulder/forearm and shin end on the very same vertical cut near x49. The face and wrist abruptly narrow in this pickup before their volume returns on the next stride.

blockers: A rectangular crop still clips the loaded figure in the pickup exposure.
